name: M10-2A-23, 1B
headline: Snazzy 1BDR w/ Rooftop @ Mangroovy |Free Pool & Beach Access
summary: This trendy 1 bedroom apartment is located in Gouna's only beachfront community with a 24/7 free pool and beach access and is managed by Xuru Stays. The apartment features a great rooftop overlooking the pool.

description.Space:
This trendy 1 bedroom apartment is located in Gouna's only beachfront residence - Mangroovy with free pool and beach access. Mangroovy is closest to the Marina (10 min walk). 

The 1 bedroom apartment comes with an open plan fully equipped kitchen, 1 full bathrooms, a guest bathroom with 1 and a living room , not to mention a beautiful bright furnished rooftop overlooking the pool. 

It also features a 65 inch smart TV with Airplay and cable channels, washing machine, a Nespresso machine, kettle and a microwave. The apartment is great for couples. 

The styling is made with a modish and calming taste to ensure guests have a wonderful and relaxing experience. 


At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment
description.Interaction:
We are more than happy to answer all of your questions 24/7. Guests can text and call anytime they need help and our team will be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Neighborhood:
-Mangroovy residence is uniquely located 800 meters from Abu Tig Marina. Guests will be able to walk 10 minutes and get to it. 
-'Bright Star' supermarket is right in front of the residence towards the Marina.
-Mangroovy is home to the 'Zouni' beach lounge (located at Mangroovy's beach)
- 'The Smokery', a local favorite is also located 450 meters from the residence.
description.Transit:
Free outdoor parking is available. 
Tuktuks are available to take you anywhere in El Gouna.
description.Notes: Please note that smoking is not allowed inside the apartment. A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.

agreement:
• Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 100 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 


Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

Negative:
We are not satisfied with our stay at Mangroovy M10-2A-23. We did like the appartement and Mangroovy overall. The location is great, the bed was comfortable and the outside pool amazing. Therefore we really hope that you use our feedback to improve the experiences of others. Also, we want to be compensated for the doorlock mistake. This really had a big impact on our final day of our holiday.
Please find our feedback below.

Check-in
It already started during our arrival. The adress details were wrong in the information you gave us (you said 12A instead of 2A). Our taxi driver and us have been looking for 12A for 30 minutes, with all suitcases and after a long travel. When we finally found the appartement, the description of how to use the lock were very vague. Also, the lock didn’t work properly already. It took us a long while before we figured it out. Not a nice way to start your holiday after a long trip.

Locked out
On our last day, we have been locked out for over 2 hours - because of empty battery of the doorlock… We called your service over 15 times and send many messages, no response. In the end, our security guy was able to get a hold off you and he tried to explain the situation. You promised to send someone, and that it would take 5 minutes. No one came, and after our security guy called again, we heard that you didn’t send anyone at all… But that NOW you would send someone. Why not send someone with the first call? Or answer our calls to explain how we were going to solve this? Finally, someone arrived from your company. He didnt speak english and was very impolite. No ‘sorry’ what so ever.
As you can imagine, this was very frustrating for us. We had no idea what happened and how long it would take. It really ruined our last night of our holiday.

Wifi
As we are working remotely, its very important to have proper working wifi. In the 2nd week, the wifi wasn’t stable. Especially the last 3 days it didn’t work at all.
The place is really nice. Just the view from the balconies aren’t really the best, literally construction sight.

Positive:
The apartment itself is nice, and the communication with the management is good. The location is fantastic, close to the pool, beach, cafes, restaurants and a supermarket.

Negative:
The apartment unfortunately had an unpleasant smell upon arrival, so I needed to keep the windows and balcony doors open for ventilation, which was fine.

The main downside for me, however, was the very loud air conditioning. The units were extremely loud, especially the one in the bedroom. The rattling noise was noticeable even through earplugs, making it difficult to sleep with the AC on, which was challenging as the room would otherwise become too warm.

Additionally, I found the seating rather uncomfortable, particularly the sofa and the seating area on the upstairs terrace.

Overall, addressing these points would significantly improve the comfort of the stay.

Negative:
* The rooftop photos do not match what was advertised. That was the main reason we booked this place, otherwise we would have chosen another apartment. We feel misled. False advertising.
The rooftop is part of the building and it’s not like in the pictures. Very dirty and locked( had to request the key specifically)
* The apartment is in very poor condition — old, dirty, bad smell, and many things are falling apart. Toilet leaking water, broken seats etc
* There is no window or ventilation in the bathroom/shower. Ventilation is very noisy and even you can hear it through the building when others are using theirs.
* The apartment is next to a construction site, so it is very noisy and dusty.
* The balcony looks neglected, with broken fake plants.
* The check-in experience was terrible. Booking says check-in starts at 14:00, but they failed to send us the QR code. Security would not let us in, they did not reply to messages, and the WhatsApp number could not be reached. We waited 1.5 hours before getting access.
* The room is extremely dusty. Especially the bed and there is no vacuum cleaner available. I even have to wear a mask while sleeping or staying inside the apartment and my husband couldn’t sleep who usually is not allergic to anything.
